name: Vanderbilt Spring 2024
information:
This competition is supported by [CubingUSA](https://www.cubingusa.org) and sponsored by Vanderbilt's Department of Mathematics.
Please make sure to read the **[Venue, Travel, and Lunch](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VanderbiltSpring2024#37497-venue-travel-and-lunch)** tab for information about parking and food. 

### **MINORS POLICY: A parent or guardian MUST be present at check-in for anyone under the age of 18 who plans to compete. Vanderbilt University requires all minors (persons under the age of 18) attending this competition to be accompanied by a parent or guardian.**
